description: stake(amount, recipient) is `whenNotPaused` but NOT `nonReentrant`. Order: _updatePool() -> if (user.amount > 0) _claimRewards(recipient) [mint phUSD + safeTransfer rewardToken to recipient] -> safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, this, amount) [pull stake] -> THEN rebase user.amount/phUSDDebt/stableDebt. Reward debt is rebased only AFTER `_claimRewards` returns; if `phUSD.mint` or `rewardToken.safeTransfer` to `recipient` yields control (recipient = attacker), the attacker can re-enter `claim()` or `withdraw()` and re-read the unrebased pending, double-claiming. Matches REENTRANCY-ERC777 signature (transferFrom/transfer + IERC20, state change after transfer, no guard). Lever is conditional on `phUSD.mint` callback semantics and on rewardToken being a hooked token; profile §8.1 lists this as the highest-priority surface.
vulnerableConditionsMet: External token interaction (mint + safeTransfer) precedes debt rebase
`recipient` is attacker-controlled, so the callback target is attacker-controlled
missingMitigations: Move debt rebase BEFORE _claimRewards external calls
Restrict reward token to non-hooked allowlist
